text:
[RCLI.2.1] **A plain `compile` emits the base `.dsc`:** the schema and rule
atoms, plus the Rete network — `AlphaNode`, `BetaNode`, `TerminalNode` — which
is the program ([RDSC.4a]).

The Rete atoms are emitted whenever the artefact is to be interpretable, which
is the default. Nothing an author writes suppresses them; only a flag does, and
in v1 no flag that suppresses them is admitted.
